description: Navigate to the 'Find the details' activity in GCompris (located in the Puzzles category, indicated by a jigsaw piece icon). In this activity, you will see a famous painting (e.g., Seurat's 'Sunday Afternoon') and specific details to locate within it. Find and click all the required details to complete the first painting level. Once the level is complete (indicated by a success animation or loading of the next painting), take a screenshot of the success state and save it to '~/art_detective_success.png'.
